about.title: About ApoDocs Nador Academic Platform
about.subtitle: Mohammed Premier University • Nador Campus
about.lead: ApoDocs is the premier collaborative academic platform serving students of Nador's 4 faculties (Mohammed Premier University), streamlining access to lecture notes, exams, and verified study materials in a secure, moderated environment.
about.mission_fr_desc: ApoDocs est née d'une volonté commune d'entraide étudiante à Nador. Notre objectif est de rassembler en un point d'accès unique l'ensemble des ressources pédagogiques des facultés de Nador (FSAN, FEGN, FSJPN, FLLAN).
about.mission_ar_desc: تأسست منصة ApoDocs استجابةً لحاجة طلبة التعليم العالي بإقليم الناظور إلى فضاء أكاديمي منظم وموثوق لتبادل المحاضرات، وملخصات الدروس، ونماذج الامتحانات السابقة مع التصحيح بطريقة تشاركية ومفتوحة.
about.feature_verified_desc: Every uploaded document undergoes moderation before publication to ensure relevance, authenticity, and academic standards.
about.feature_privacy_desc: Full real name is kept strictly confidential for administrative purposes, while public pseudonyms protect your privacy.
about.feature_free_desc: No subscription or account creation is required to browse, search, and download study materials.
